lines.text: The psalm invites us to sing for joy and shout to the Rock of our salvation.
The LORD is a great King above all gods, and the sea is His because He made it.
We are invited to bow down and kneel before the LORD our Maker, the sheep under His care.
The warning says not to harden our hearts as at Sinai and Massah, where the fathers tested God.
For twenty years God was angry with that generation and swore they would never enter His rest.
